# 🎨 Mod Contours

![Mod Icon](https://applyok.ru/icon.png)

**Mod Contours** is a client-side mod for Minecraft Forge that helps organize your inventory by visually grouping items from the same mod using dynamic colored outlines. If you're tired of getting lost in an inventory filled with hundreds of items from different mods, Mod Contours is made for you!

## ✨ Showcase

![Mod Showcase](https://applyok.ru/gifka.gif)

## 🚀 Features

* **Dynamic Outlines:** Items from the same mod are automatically grouped together with a shared colored outline.
* **Smart Detection:** The mod automatically identifies which mod each item belongs to.
* **High Performance:** Designed with minimal impact on game performance.
* **Fully Configurable:** Customize outline thickness, fill transparency, and outline style through the configuration file.
* **Multilingual:** The interface and documentation are available in multiple languages.

## 📦 Installation

1. Make sure you have Minecraft Forge installed: https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/
2. Download the latest version of the mod:

   * GitHub Releases: https://github.com/mrdiovkrad/ModContours/releases
   * Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/mod/modcontours
   * CurseForge: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/modcontours *(Coming Soon)*
3. Place the downloaded `.jar` file into the `mods` folder in your Minecraft directory.
4. Launch the game and enjoy!

## ⚙️ Configuration

All mod settings can be changed through the in-game mod configuration menu. You can customize:

* Outline thickness
* Fill transparency
* Outline style
* And many other settings for the perfect appearance!

## 🌍 Supported Languages

* English
* Russian
* German
* Spanish
* French
* Chinese (Simplified)
* Japanese
* Portuguese (Brazil)
* Polish
* Korean
